targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS upcoming_events FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(*) AS events_today FROM events WHERE datum = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT count(*) AS events_next_7_days FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE AND datum < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
SELECT count(DISTINCT source) AS active_sources FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE
SELECT datum::timestamp AS time, source AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY datum, source ORDER BY datum, source

SELECT COALESCE(l.district, 'unknown') AS district, count(*) AS events FROM events e LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(category), ''), 'uncategorized') AS category, count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT to_char(von, 'HH24:00') AS hour, count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(source, ''), 'unknown') AS source, count(*) AS events FROM events WHERE datum >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT l.name AS location, COALESCE(l.district, '') AS district, count(*) AS upcoming_events FROM events e JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY l.name, l.district ORDER BY upcoming_events DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT e.datum, e.von, e.bis, e.thema AS title, l.name AS location, COALESCE(l.district, '') AS district, (e.bis - e.von) AS duration FROM events e JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY duration DESC NULLS LAST, e.datum, e.von LIMIT 40

SELECT e.datum, e.von, e.bis, e.thema AS title, COALESCE(l.name, '') AS location, COALESCE(l.district, '') AS district, COALESCE(e.category, '') AS category, COALESCE(e.source, '') AS source FROM events e LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = e.location_id WHERE e.datum >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY e.datum, e.von NULLS LAST LIMIT 80
